result.topic_en: Draft of a letter by Riemann to a professor, dated Göttingen 5 October 1861, saying he cannot sign a jointly drafted report on a proposed Central European arc measurement (Gradmessung) and will submit a separate report to the Royal Curatorium; pencil drafts of a report passage follow.
